verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a consumer GPU, a piece of hardware. It is not a data-collecting service with a training-data policy or opt-out control, so a training-data opt-out story is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the card itself ingests user data for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
